summary: An original, runnable runx skill package (SKILL.md + X.yaml + run.mjs + fixtures) that triages a CI failure into flake/infra/real-break/dep and emits a typed runx.ci.triage.v1 packet. It demonstrates real runx usage end to end: a green 2-case harness and a signed receipt that `runx verify` recomputes as valid.
audience: Developers and maintainers evaluating runx for governed agent skills, and anyone learning how to author a runx cli-tool skill with harness cases and verifiable receipts.
why_allowed: This is an original public GitHub repository authored by the submitter that uses and links to runx; GitHub repositories are the canonical place to share open-source tooling and examples, so a runx demo/example repo is on-topic and allowed.
observations: runx harness <abs path> => status passed, cases [real_break_clear_logs, ambiguous_truncated_logs]
runx verify --receipt <id>.json => valid=true (digest valid, content_address valid, signature valid/production)
README links to https://runx.ai and https://github.com/runxhq/runx
